paragraphs: We’re excited to share that Nature’s Gate is now a part of the Mild by Nature family of products. You can still expect the same eco-conscious and nature-inspired formulas, just with a new brand and a new family of effective personal care products.

Excess oil can leave your hair flat and lifeless. Mild by Nature Nature’s Gate Shampoo for Oily Hair helps restore life and movement back into your locks with a unique blend of herbal extracts. Our advanced formula is designed to remove oil buildup, while also refreshing and nourishing hair.

Featuring tea tree oil and sea buckthorn, this revitalizing shampoo uses ingredients from nature to gently cleanse hair and help reduce excess oil. Plus, nourishing botanicals like jojoba, rosemary, and watercress help to refresh the scalp and add balanced moisture to oily hair.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Massage a generous amount of shampoo gently into wet hair and scalp. Work into rich lather. Rinse thoroughly.
For best results, follow with Nature’s Gate Tea Tree & Sea Buckthorn Conditioner. May be used daily.
